g.text:soa: The Stuckists set out to critique it, by means of pamphleteering, demonstrating, fly postering and other public protestation and interventions.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Pepe Espaliu

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: South American artist born in the 1960s who made a piece of work with a large quantity of old clothes, involving him cycling round the trunk of a tree on a platform that encircled the trunk just below the canopy.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Angus Fairhurst

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: British artist born in the 1960s who makes drawings and collages and digitally animated drawing videos.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Peter Fend

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Artist born in the 1960s who made a film of himself jumping around with only a jumper and a pair of shoes on.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Pierre Huyghe

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Swiss artist who makes photographs and videos.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: One photograph shows a stone frozen in mid air over a motorway.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The stone looks like a boulder implying impending tragedy as it will surely cause a terrible accident, until the viewer realises that it is a tiny pebble that has been photographed as it drops from a bridge over the speeding cars.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Inventory

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: British artist group who make socially engaged and political work and publish a journal, Inventory.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Inventory’s work usually consists of installations, often some kind of stand or kiosk like structure, with a variety of photographic and text works.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: They take the position of proselytisers for a new way of life, highlighting the dystopian elements in everyday life and imagining collective actions.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: An example is a photo collage of London in 2002 showing the city as if it were about to collapse.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Inventory have spray painted anti American slogans on the walls of a museum in which they were invited to show.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Christian Jankowski

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: German artist born in the 1970s who makes video, installation and sound work.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: In Bank, Jankowski hired security guards to keep people out of a empty disused bank, the result of which was that people wanted to enter a space they ordinarily would have ignored.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: In another work Jankoswki recorded a board meeting at a national art museum, and then got children to speak the transcript.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Because the children had no understanding of the issues discussed they gave the transcript an entirely new and rather odd emphasis.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Jankowski often uses actors.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: In another work he asks actors to record the reading of the extended email correspondence between himself and his girlfriend when they were apart for several months.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Again he was interested in the different inflexion and emphases given to the transcript.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Jankoswki is interested in what happens if slight subversions are made to everyday materials and locations.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Elke Krystufek

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Austrian artist born in 1970s whose subject is herself and her own body portrayed in videos, drawings and paintings of herself in her daily life.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: However Krystufek often appears naked, usually made up with the red lipstick which is characteristic of the videos and the drawings, sometimes in an abject state and her work is also a portrait of neurosis.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Her emotional state is usually unexplained.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: A video self portrait is shot with a hand held (thus never more than arms length away) as she spins around dancing.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Her own apartment is often the setting for the work.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Lucy McKenzie

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Scottish artist born in the late 1970s, although chiefly thought of as a painter, Mackenzie’s practise is extensive, ranging from painting, drawing, printmaking and writing, to video, installation, dj ing, and event organising.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: She has also used her work to promote the activities of charities, such as one that supports women in Eastern Europe who are trafficked as prostitutes.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Mackenzie's polymorphous practise is the result of an ideological and socially engaged approach to art as a medium with the power to transform daily life.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: At the same time her work references early twentieth century art, particularly that of Russia and Germany both iconographically and in her creating of social events.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Her paintings and works on paper often borrow apparently anachronistic historical graphic styles, and have featured athletes, Olympic rings, and graphic and geometric patterns.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Or they may be graffiti like, borrowing from classical art and include text.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: They are painted in faded out colours, drawn roughly or printed, often on cheap paper.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: This is in itself is a symbolic act, as cheap paper and printing methods seem entirely anachronistic in western Europe today, where they are still the norm in many parts of the world.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: In some sense Mackenzie’s work reflects the state of the body politic, in other senses it is a reflection on the practise of art.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: She started a club night in her native Glasgow that was and remains a focus for artists and musicians.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: She also ran a club in Warsaw with Pauline Olowskowa, a long term collaborator, at which they presented events including music, poetry and readings.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: A video made in 2003 shows Mackenzie and Olowskowa working together in an empty space.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Mackenzie is drawing Olowskowa who seems to be doing nothing but talking on the phone.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Mackenzie also uses text in her large paintings and painted wall sized murals.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: A recent printed work features a year planner poster for 2004, blank, with all the weekends blocked out in yellow highlighter pen.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Jonathan Meese

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: German artist born around 1970 Meese made a number of works in which he covered the walls and ceiling of the exhibition space with a vast quantity of found material, photographs, drawings, images from magazines, in fact any visual material.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Discernable themes might emerge.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The effect is that of a teenage bedroom vastly expanded, with adult subject matter.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Sometimes the material might be sent by post to the gallery by the artist, and the gallery left to mount it on the wall as they wished.
